title: Art bible / confirmed foundations
summary: Owner-confirmed direction retained after the reset. The categorized Unreal image library is pending stage 3. These decisions are not completed art deliverables; use Plan → Progress for execution status.

items.title: The company and the janitor
items.body: **Owner-confirmed setting.** A janitor works in a pharmaceutical company, cleaning the consequences of clandestine experiments and facing transformed employees. The art supports this company and its contrast between public presentation and hidden work.

items.title: 1970s corporate interiors + medieval fantasy
items.body: **Owner direction.** Predominantly 1970s corporate interiors, with medieval fantasy accents; a blend of semi-realism and stylization. No numerical style ratio or new palette is approved by this reset.

items.title: Public polish / neglected service spaces
items.body: Public spaces are clean, polished and professional. Hidden service areas are neglected and can feel dungeon-like. Apply this contrast through actual environments and materials, with fresh Unreal references in stage 3.

items.title: Existing Unreal materials first
items.body: Use `/Game/Art/MI/Utility_Materials` for asset material decisions. Reuse tileables, trims and the current atlas system before proposing missing surfaces. Final production-reference images must come from Unreal; source albedos and generated concepts are not equivalent evidence.

items.title: Density and intentional tileable exceptions
items.body: The owner confirmed 256/512 px/m as normal references. Some floors and ceilings intentionally differ to align tileable textures. Preserve those UV scales and material tiling. Recheck current file links during stage 2.

items.title: Wizard mascot / prototype to standardize
items.body: **Owner-selected identity.** A simple figure with a wizard hat and staff, used as the company/game spokesperson across signs and decoration. Source prototypes remain in `Utility_Materials/TrimSheet&Atlas/General_Atlas/Resources/Pet`. Master design and consistent poses are stage 4; none has been regenerated in the reset.

items.title: Signage and UI / definition pending
items.body: Stage 5 will define coherent typography, signs, decoration, mascot applications and the current UI. **Confirmed:** English game text with future localization; Unreal graphics/UI under `/Game/Art/UI`; characters under `/Game/Art/Characters`. Review examples before atlas or UI implementation.

items.title: Reference library and review status
items.body: Stage 3 will organize Unreal captures by environments, materials, assets and characters, with dedicated mascot and signage/UI entries. Owner originals remain in project `Temp`; they are not a replacement for fresh captures. Keep proposals, implementation, technical checks and owner approval distinct. The retired production image galleries have been removed.
